'''Harikrishna Mehta''' is credited on [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards]] with the original concept of one card: [[Melas (V) (Virtual Block 1)|•Melas (V)]].<ref name="labels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images. Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref><ref name="pcimages">Players Committee card images at res.starwarsccg.org (Virtual Sets 0–27, Virtual Premium and alternate images at 745 × 1039; Virtual Blocks 1–9 and Virtual Shields at 350 × 490), the source the card label data was read from. Each card's article shows its image.</ref> The printed concept credit names the tournament or award with the concept: "Berkeley V-Lite 2005" on •Melas (V) ([[Virtual Block 1]]). The credited card was printed in [[Virtual Block 1]] (2009). Harikrishna Mehta is listed on [[Card Credits#Harikrishna Mehta|Card Credits]].

He finished 3rd at a tournament run by [[Steve Sanders]] at the Coronado Public Library in Coronado, California, on 8 January 2005, with 6 (+33), playing WYS and Hunt Down battling.<ref name="pcf-4290-58925">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=58925#58925 Southern California -FINALLY], Steve Sanders, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (25 December 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050213133831/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=59670%26amp Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pcf-4290-59686">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=59686#59686 Southern California -FINALLY], Cam Solusar, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (9 January 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050213133831/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=59670%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>
